goal: For each repository-wide lockfile census, deliver statistically accurate facts about all .github/workflows/*.lock.yml files, independently reconciled to the immutable input population.
acceptance: A retained numeric statistical assertion matches an independent native YAML/JSON census of the full, source-bound checkout. The entire report, recommendations, resource limits and publication require separate evidence.

primary.formula: Count distinct numeric report assertions independently reconciled to native facts over the complete eligible lockfile population; deduplicate by original run, assertion meaning and input population.
primary.zero: Only a bound report with an exhaustive assessed assertion inventory and no matching numeric assertion can establish zero.
primary.missing: Absent original report, ambiguous input revision, unreviewed source profile or incomplete input census yields null, not zero.

scope.files: All immediate regular .github/workflows/*.lock.yml files in the proven checkout commit, without sampling.
scope.opportunity: Initial scheduled or manually dispatched lockfile-stats executions and independently source-bound equivalent censuses; reruns do not create new deliveries.
scope.sourceCompatibility: V4 semantics beginning at the category self-check repair, with runtime/frontmatter-only differences reviewed separately. Older executions remain inventoried but cannot be silently relabeled as V4.

nativeFamilies: lockfile count and byte size min/mean/max/total
discussion categories, default category and unresolved/fallback counts
job, step and run-script totals and maxima
agent-job permission maps and per-scope distribution
all-job permission union and write-workflow count
metadata engine id, model, versions and declared fallback counts
manifest MCP server/tool frequencies and legacy fallback count
JSON byte-size and parser-availability acceptance gates
retained daily history and deltas when exact historical identities exist
schemaAdaptation: The source prescribes semantics but not JSON member spelling. An adapter may map unambiguously named fields to frozen native facts, never infer a numeric claim from prose, fuzzy-match values, change units silently or select fields for favorable results. Preserve every mapped assertion, mismatch and unsupported field.
nativeRules: Parse with pinned PyYAML safe_load; preserve raw input byte lengths; account for its YAML 1.1 on-key boolean normalization.
Resolve engine from first-line gh-aw-metadata agent_id, then sole engine_versions key, then an unambiguous GH_AW_ENGINE_ID environment value; unresolved is explicit.
Read permissions from jobs.agent and separately union all job grants; scalar read-all/write-all remain explicit, not invented finite scope maps.
Read GH_AW_SAFE_OUTPUTS_CONFIG as JSON from agent steps; deduplicate the handler copy and fail on conflicting configurations; never scrape discussion_category.
Prefer gh-aw-manifest mcp_servers, use allowed-tool comments only for absent legacy manifests, retain fallback counts.
A run-script is a step with a string run value; structural counts are YAML nodes, not shell command estimates.
Compare integer counts exactly and fractional native statistics only within the explicitly displayed rounding precision; retain exact unrounded expected quantities.
Cache history is evidence discovery; an older cached date alone is not original run/source/input binding.
Protected upload proves which bytes were retained, not whether those bytes or the report's recommendations were correct.

classification.reason: The same accurate repository census could have been produced by a person or other tool before adoption. Git reconstructs inputs but does not prove that a historical accurate assertion was delivered. Probe baseline Git and retained output interfaces; never manufacture a baseline from today's oracle.

separateUnknowns: Interestingness, recommendation usefulness and downstream decisions are not established by numeric reconciliation.
Five-bash-turn and one-million-token limits need complete original tool/usage receipts.
Publication in audits requires a protected persisted-effect receipt or immutable independently bound original Discussion.
Retention of daily history does not establish the originality or input identity of older cached entries.
No keep threshold, cost, sole attribution or causal improvement is assumed.
